rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to claim Carer's Credit

rules.description: Applicant must be under State Pension age
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim Carer's Credit if you have reached State Pension age

rules.description: Applicant must be caring for at least 20 hours per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be caring for someone for at least 20 hours a week to qualify for Carer's Credit

rules.description: Applicant must not already be receiving Carer's Allowance or Carer Support Payment
rules.reason_if_failed: You automatically get National Insurance credits if you receive Carer's Allowance or Carer Support Payment. You do not need to apply separately.

rules.description: Applicant must not already be receiving automatic credits through Child Benefit for a child under 12
rules.reason_if_failed: You automatically get National Insurance credits if you receive Child Benefit for a child under the age of 12. You do not need to apply separately.

rules.description: The person being cared for must receive a qualifying disability benefit OR have a signed Care Certificate
rules.reason_if_failed: The person you care for must receive a qualifying benefit (DLA, PIP, Attendance Allowance, etc.) or you must provide a Care Certificate signed by a health or social care professional

edge_cases.action: Foster carers should apply for National Insurance credits through the foster care scheme instead. Route to alternative service.

edge_cases.description: Break in caring responsibilities exceeds 12 weeks
edge_cases.action: Applicant must contact the Carer's Allowance Unit to report break. May affect eligibility for the period.
Credits can be claimed for caring for multiple people. Ensure total caring hours are documented correctly.

edge_cases.description: Care recipient does not receive qualifying benefit, so Care Certificate is needed
edge_cases.action: Applicant must obtain Care Certificate signed by a health or social care professional. This requires human coordination and cannot be fully automated.
